@@U02081@@
My lover was near,
but he’s far away now;
and the garland torn,
blossoms scattered.
Not so rough!
Take hold gently!
Spare me!
Don't let me beg in vain!
What did I ever do to you?
I never saw you before!

@@U02083@@
How can I bear this misery!

@@U02085@@
I’m in your hands now,
at your mercy.
But first let me nurse my baby.
I cuddled it all last night, you know,
and then they came
and took it away,
to grieve me,
grieve me,
and now they say I murdered it.
And [ll never be happy again.
And they make up songs about me,
they do,
and they sing them,
and it’s bad of them,
wicked!
There's an old tale that ends like that—
but why mix it up with me?

@@U02087@@
(Throwing himself at her feet.)

@@U02088@@
A lover lies here at your feet,
come to free you of this captive misery!

@@U02090@@
(Throwing herself down beside him.)

@@U02091@@
Yes, oh, yes,
translation:
@@U02081@@
我的爱人就在附近，
但他现在已经很远了；
和撕裂的花环，
花朵散落。
没那么粗暴！
轻轻地握住！
饶了我吧！
别让我白白哀求！
我对你做了什么？
我以前从没见过你！

@@U02083@@
我怎能承受这样的痛苦！

@@U02085@@
我现在在你手中，
听凭你的摆布。
但首先让我给我的孩子喂奶。
昨晚我一直拥抱它，你知道，
然后他们来了
并把它拿走了，
让我伤心，
让我伤心，
现在他们说我谋杀了它。
并且[永远不会再快乐。
他们创作了关于我的歌曲，
他们这样做，
他们唱歌，
这对他们来说很糟糕，
邪恶！
有一个古老的故事，结局是这样的——
但为什么和我混在一起呢？

@@U02087@@
（扑倒在她脚边。）

@@U02088@@
一个爱人躺在你的脚下，
快来把你从这种被囚禁的痛苦中解脱出来吧！

@@U02090@@
（扑倒在他身边。）

@@U02091@@
是啊，哦，是啊，
